root_idea.summary: The root centers on interpenetration or entanglement together with rising or elevation.
root_idea.development: From the intermingling of branches and the upward growth of trees, the lexicon develops meanings of trees and wooded growth, entangled or disputed affairs, commingling, raising or supporting, and related wooden implements.

qac_form_accounting.reason: Displayed as the Quran-attested Form I verb.
Displayed as the Quran-attested collective nominal.
Displayed as the Quran-attested singular nominal.

senses.definition: To become entangled as a matter of disagreement or dispute; to arise as a disputed matter.
senses.usage_conditions: In فِيمَا شَجَرَ بَيْنَهُمْ, it describes an issue that has become complicated or disputed among the parties.

senses.definition: Trees, shrubs, or woody-stemmed plants; collectively, vegetation with a stem or trunk.
senses.usage_conditions: A collective noun whose referent can include trees and shrubs and, in some Quranic contexts, vegetation more generally.

senses.definition: A tree or woody plant; the singular unit of شَجَرٌ.
senses.usage_conditions: Used for an individual tree or plant. Quranic qualifications such as blessed, evil, or accursed tree specify the referent or figurative context rather than creating a different basic lexical meaning; traditional identifications of some such trees vary.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A discordant, complicated, or confused affair or case.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A nominal use describing an affair characterized by entanglement or disagreement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To tie or fasten a thing.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Transitive use with a thing as object.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To thrust or pierce someone with a spear so that it remains stuck in him.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The spear construction specifies piercing with retention of the weapon.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To avert, divert, withhold, or repel someone or something from an affair.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Constructed with عَنْ to express turning or keeping away from a matter.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To prop up a house or tent with a pole.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The object is supported by a pole or comparable upright.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To raise or lift hanging branches, plants, or a lowered garment.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Also used absolutely of something being raised, upraised, or elevated.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To force open the mouth with a stick, or to make an animal open its mouth by pulling its bridle.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The action involves inserting a piece of wood or jerking a bridle to open or curb the mouth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To place or throw a thing onto a wooden rack or stand.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The rack is the مِشْجَر or related wooden stand.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become numerous or large in aggregate; according to one description, to become gathered and then dispersed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The reported descriptions differ over whether dispersal is included in the use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The laying of palm racemes upon branches to prevent them from breaking.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A horticultural operation performed when the fruit and racemes are heavy.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of cattle, to pasture upon trees or shrubs after consuming herbs and leguminous plants.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A Form III use describing grazing on woody growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To contend, dispute, or litigate with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A reciprocal Form III construction with two disputing parties.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of land, to produce trees or shrubs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Form IV use with the land as the subject.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become knit, connected, commingled, intricate, or confused, one part with another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The Form VIII use can describe physical interlacing or a state of entanglement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To become embroiled in conflict, contend, disagree, or thrust at one another with spears.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: With spears, the construction can describe their interlocking or their thrusting and piercing one another; with people, it describes dispute or disagreement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To precede, outgo, or outstrip another.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A distinct Form VIII use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of sleep, to withdraw or keep aloof from someone.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used of sleep that does not come or does not remain with a person.

other_classical_meanings.definition: To place the hand beneath the chin and lean upon the elbow without lying on one's side.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A posture described with the related noun شَجْر for the area beneath the chin.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Of a horse, to be bridled, reined, or curbed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: This reported use is expressed tentatively in the lexical evidence and may involve a passive reading.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The part of a camel saddle between its two principal joining pieces.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical saddle term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The chin or a part of the mouth and lower-jaw region, including the opening or meeting area of the jaws.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Authorities extend the anatomical term to related portions of the mouth; it is also used of the corresponding region in a horse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A person's stock, lineage, or origin; figuratively, a genealogical tree or pedigree.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Figurative use in expressions such as being of a good or prophetic stock.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small speck or speckle on a boy's chin.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An attributed, specialized use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The shape, size, and appearance of a she-camel's udder, including its veins, skin, and flesh.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A figurative expression applied specifically to the form or substance of an udder.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The articulatory letters ج, ش, and ض.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical phonetic term for letters whose place of articulation is called the شَجْر.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The wood or wooden apparatus by which a well-bucket is drawn out.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A technical implement term; a cited plural reading is disputed in the reported verse.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A wooden bar or piece placed behind a door.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A household wooden fastening.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of wood affixed beneath a couch-frame to repair or reinforce it.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A support or reinforcing piece for a bed or couch frame.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A piece of wood placed in a kid's mouth to prevent it from suckling.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A livestock implement.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A brand or mark made with a hot iron on camels.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized animal-marking term.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Abounding in trees or shrubs, said of a valley or land.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The adjective applies to a place rich in woody growth.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Strange or belonging to another; a stranger.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Applied to a man or a camel.

other_classical_meanings.definition: An arrow used in the game of maysir that is not from the same kind of tree as the other arrows, or a borrowed arrow associated with a favorable omen.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized gambling and divination term with variant explanations.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Bad, corrupt, or disapproved.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival use reported from particular authorities.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A companion or friend.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The plural is شُجَرَاءُ.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A sword.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A specialized nominal use.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Things that withhold, debar, or divert.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A plural noun used for obstacles or diverting factors.

other_classical_meanings.definition: More wooded or containing more trees or shrubs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: Used comparatively of one tract of land relative to another.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place where trees or shrubs grow; by extension, a place rich in trees.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place noun, with a variant interpretation as a large quantity of trees.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A place or occasion of contending, disputing, or litigating.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place noun derived from the branch of disputation.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Land that produces or supports the growth of trees or shrubs.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of fertile or wooded land.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A rack or stand made from pieces of wood tied together, on which clothes, furniture, or utensils are placed.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A structure with bound wooden pieces and splayed feet, also called a مِشْجَب.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The wooden framework or pieces of wood of a woman's howdah.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: The term may refer to the frame itself or to the wood used in it.

other_classical_meanings.definition: A small women's vehicle, smaller than a howdah and open at the top.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An alternative nominal use for the uncovered vehicle made from or associated with the framework.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Figured work patterned in the form of trees, including tree-patterned silk brocade.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A descriptive passive participle for ornament or textile design.

other_classical_meanings.definition: The place where spears commingle or where spears are thrust and pierce.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: A place noun describing spear combat.

other_classical_meanings.definition: Commingled or confused, especially said of spears.
other_classical_meanings.usage_conditions: An adjectival description of intermingled weapons.

lane_unit_coverage.note: Covers the Quranic dispute construction and the tree term derived from intermingled branches.

cautions: The Quranic tree expressions include qualified and figurative references whose traditional identifications can vary; the basic lexical sense remains tree or woody plant.
The reported horse-bridle sense of اِشْتَجَرَ is retained as a tentative classical usage because the source itself signals uncertainty about its voice and attribution.
